cards.description: 该研究提出门控共形语义风险控制方法，将收益寻求的强化学习分配与文本条件化的下行风险验证分离，为组合优化提供可回放、可校准的预交易风险证书。其新意在于用语义风险状态和共形校准构建不确定性集，并通过不对称二阶锥门控仅拦截超出风险预算的提案，从而在保留收益的同时消除风险限额违规。
cards.summaryEn: Facts: In walk-forward out-of-sample tests on nine liquid U.S. Select Sector SPDR ETFs, Raw PPO earns a 12.7% annual return with a 4.05% semantic violation rate; the gated approach removes all observed out-of-sample semantic limit breaches while retaining an 11.7% annual return, with exact McNemar testing at p < 10^{-15}. Author's view: This 100-basis-point "auditable safety premium" is smaller than the yield loss imposed by unconditional hard projection, and lexicon controls and time-shuffled text controls fail to reproduce the certificate.
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法为自动化组合系统提供了预交易审计轨迹、可解释风险限额和人工监督机制，回应监管对强化学习策略风险认证的需求；其门控设计在消除观察到的语义限额突破的同时仅付出有限收益代价，介于原始策略与无条件硬投影之间。
keyPointsEn: Gated Conformal Semantic Risk Control separates return-seeking allocation from text-conditioned risk verification, with a language model mapping disclosures to schema-validated semantic risk states.

Semantic risk states induce correlated ellipsoidal factor-shock uncertainty sets whose conformal radii are calibrated by rolling finite-sample prediction over localized semantic nonconformity buckets.
An asymmetric second-order cone gate intervenes only when a proposal exceeds the certified worst-case semantic loss budget, remaining inactive for compliant proposals.
cards.originalTitle: Conformal Risk Certificates for Portfolio Optimization Under Uncertainty: A Gated Reinforcement-Learning Approach
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes Gated Conformal Semantic Risk Control, which separates return-seeking reinforcement-learning allocation from text-conditioned downside-risk verification, providing a replayable and calibrated pre-trade risk certificate for portfolio optimization. Its novelty lies in using semantic risk states and conformal calibration to construct uncertainty sets and an asymmetric second-order cone gate that only blocks proposals exceeding the risk budget, thereby preservi
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自九个流动性较好的美国行业SPDR ETF的滚动样本外测试，未覆盖其他资产类别、市场状态或更长样本；语义违规率与收益差异为特定回测设置下的观察结果，不构成对未来实盘表现的保证；共形证书依赖语言模型风险状态映射与局部校准桶的有限样本有效性，模型误差或分布漂移可能削弱证书可靠性；未讨论交易成本、容量约束与多重检验对结论的影响。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The method provides automated portfolio systems with a pre-trade audit trail, interpretable risk limits, and a human-oversight mechanism, addressing regulatory demands for risk certification of reinforcement-learning strategies; its gated design eliminates observed semantic limit breaches at a limited return cost, falling between the raw policy and unconditional hard projection.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes only from walk-forward out-of-sample tests on nine liquid U.S. Select Sector SPDR ETFs and does not cover other asset classes, market regimes, or longer samples; the semantic violation rate and return differences are observations under a specific backtest setup and do not guarantee future live performance; the conformal certificate relies on the finite-sample validity of the language-model risk-state mapping and local calibration buckets, and model error or distribution shift may weaken certificate reliability; trading costs, capacity constraints, and multiple-testing effects on the conclusions are not discussed.
cards.title: 门控共形风险证书为强化学习组合优化提供可审计预交易验证
cards.summary: 事实：在九个美国行业SPDR ETF的滚动样本外测试中，原始PPO年化收益12.7%但语义违规率4.05%；门控方法消除所有观察到的样本外语义限额突破，年化收益11.7%，精确McNemar检验p<10^{-15}。作者观点：该100个基点的“可审计安全溢价”小于无条件硬投影的收益损失，且词典控制与时间打乱文本控制无法复现证书。
cards.titleEn: Gated Conformal Risk Certificates Provide Auditable Pre-Trade Validation for Reinforcement-Learning Portfolio Optimization
keyPoints: 门控共形语义风险控制将收益分配与文本条件化风险验证分离，语言模型将披露映射为模式验证的语义风险状态。
语义风险状态诱导相关椭球因子冲击不确定性集，其共形半径通过滚动有限样本预测在局部语义非一致性桶中校准。
不对称二阶锥门控仅在提案超出认证最坏情况语义损失预算时介入，合规提案保持门控不活跃。

cards.description: 该研究将季节性作为预测全球期货市场风险调整收益的因子，发现五类季节性异象在债券、商品和股票市场普遍存在，且不能被现有 carry、动量与偏度因子解释。其新意在于用非线性统计学习为每个市场-特征对拟合独特季节模式，并区分快慢季节模式的净表现；有用性在于展示季节性因子与主流时序因子低相关，加入组合可提升样本外夏普约30%。
cards.summaryEn: The research documents five seasonality anomalies that are pervasive across global futures markets and whose excess returns are not reasonably explained by global time-series carry, momentum and skewness factors. The authors fit nonlinear seasonality models at the market level using statistical learning and report walk-forward out-of-sample tests: fast patterns such as day-of-week and day-of-month show strong gross performance but extremely high turnover and negative net performance after costs; slower patterns such as day-of-quarter, day-of-half-year and day-of-year show positive gross performance and, except day-of-quarter, positive net performance. The authors argue an equal-weight ensemble of seasonality models has an out-of-sample Sharpe ratio competitive with and uncorrelated to established global time-series factor portfolios, and adding seasonality to a global factor portfolio increases out-of-sample Sharpe by approximately 30% over the full evaluation period.
cards.whyItMatters: 对量化因子研究而言，该工作提示季节性可作为独立于主流时序因子的收益来源，但净收益高度依赖换手与交易成本；慢速季节模式更可能具备可实施性，而快速模式在成本约束下难以保留。
keyPointsEn: Five seasonality anomalies are pervasive across bond, commodity and equity futures and are not explained by carry, momentum and skewness factors.

Fast seasonal patterns (day-of-week, day-of-month) have strong gross returns but extremely high turnover and negative net performance after transaction costs; slower patterns (day-of-quarter, day-of-half-year, day-of-year) have positive gross performance and, except day-of-quarter, positive net performance.
The equal-weight seasonality ensemble is uncorrelated with established global time-series factor portfolios and raises out-of-sample Sharpe by about 30% when added over the full evaluation period.
cards.descriptionEn: The study treats seasonality as a factor for predicting risk-adjusted returns across global futures markets. It documents five seasonality anomalies pervasive in bond, commodity and equity markets that are not explained by established carry, momentum and skewness factors. Its novelty lies in fitting nonlinear seasonality models at the individual market level via statistical learning and distinguishing net performance of fast versus slow seasonal patterns; its usefulness is sh
cards.limitations: 证据边界包括：结论基于作者设定的全球期货市场样本与走步样本外检验，未覆盖其他资产类别或交易成本假设变化；快慢模式净表现对换手和成本估计敏感；经济解释为候选 rationale，尚未形成统一因果识别；夏普提升约30%为组合层面样本外结果，不等于可独立复制的投资策略收益。
cards.whyItMattersEn: For quantitative factor research, the work suggests seasonality can be a return source independent of mainstream time-series factors, but net returns depend heavily on turnover and transaction costs; slower seasonal patterns are more likely implementable, while fast patterns may not survive cost constraints.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundaries include: conclusions are based on the authors' global futures sample and walk-forward out-of-sample tests, not other asset classes or alternative transaction-cost assumptions; fast and slow pattern net performance is sensitive to turnover and cost estimates; economic rationales are candidate explanations without unified causal identification; the roughly 30% Sharpe improvement is a portfolio-level out-of-sample result and does not equate to a replicable investment strategy return.
cards.title: 全球季节性因子投资：慢速季节模式净夏普优于快速模式
cards.summary: 研究记录五类季节性异象在全球期货市场普遍存在，且各季节因子产生的超额收益无法由全球时序 carry、动量和偏度因子合理解释。作者采用统计学习拟合市场层面的非线性季节模型，并报告走步样本外检验：日/周内等快速模式毛表现强但换手极高、扣除成本后为负；季度内、半年内和年内等慢速模式毛表现正，除季度内外净表现也为正。作者认为等权季节模型组合的样本外夏普可与既有全球时序因子组合竞争且不相关，加入全球因子组合后全评估期样本外夏普提升约30%。
cards.titleEn: Global Seasonality Factor Investing: Slow Seasonal Patterns Outperform Fast Ones on a Net Sharpe Basis
keyPoints: 五类季节性异象在债券、商品和股票期货中普遍存在，且不能被 carry、动量和偏度因子解释。
快速季节模式（星期几、月内日）毛收益强但换手极高，扣交易成本后净表现为负；慢速模式（季度内、半年内、年内日）除季度内外净表现为正。
等权季节模型组合与既有全球时序因子组合不相关，加入后全评估期样本外夏普提升约30%。

cards.description: 新方法MINGLE通过因子暴露定义图局部性，联合学习因子与图结构，较传统相关性图更贴合经济板块，组合表现更优。
cards.summaryEn: Existing portfolio methods either ignore idiosyncratic shocks or the latent structure driving systematic returns. MINGLE redefines graph locality through systematic factor exposure profiles and uses ADMM to jointly learn latent factors and graph topology. The authors report that resulting portfolios outperform correlation-based counterparts across volatility regimes and transaction cost levels.
cards.whyItMatters: 若暴露图能稳定反映经济结构，组合构建可减少对观测协动及其有限样本伪影的依赖，为分散化提供更贴近基本面的依据。
keyPointsEn: MINGLE replaces correlation-based graph locality with similarity in systematic factor exposures.
A unified ADMM framework jointly learns factor representation and graph topology from market returns.
Exposure-similarity graphs align more closely with established economic sectors than correlation-based graphs.
cards.originalTitle: Beyond Co-Movement: Locality by Exposures Enables a Joint Factor-Graph Framework for Portfolio Diversification
cards.descriptionEn: MINGLE defines graph locality via factor exposures and jointly learns factor and graph structures, yielding graphs that align better with economic sectors and portfolios that outperform correlation-based counterparts.
cards.limitations: 结论基于作者在特定数据集与波动率/交易成本设定下的回测，样本外稳健性、不同市场与资产类别的可迁移性尚未验证；统计显著性检验仅支持图-因子域协调带来增益的解释，不构成投资建议。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If exposure graphs reliably reflect economic structure, portfolio construction can rely less on observed co-movement and finite-sample artifacts, grounding diversification in fundamentals.
cards.limitationsEn: Findings are based on the authors' backtests under specific datasets and volatility/transaction cost settings; out-of-sample robustness and transferability to other markets or asset classes remain unverified. Statistical tests support the interpretation that gains stem from reconciling graph and factor domains, not investment advice.
cards.title: 基于因子暴露的图局部性提升组合分散化
cards.summary: 现有组合构建方法或忽略特质冲击，或忽略驱动系统性收益的潜在数据结构。MINGLE框架通过因子暴露轮廓重新定义图局部性，并用ADMM联合学习潜在因子表示与图拓扑。作者报告由此构建的组合在多种波动率与交易成本下优于相关性方法。
cards.titleEn: Exposure-Based Graph Locality Improves Portfolio Diversification
keyPoints: MINGLE用系统性因子暴露相似性替代相关性定义图局部性。
ADMM统一框架直接从市场收益联合学习因子表示与图拓扑。
暴露相似性图比相关性图更贴合既有经济板块划分。

cards.description: 该工作发布开放数据集 KernelMosaic，将多样 CUDA 任务与经验证的解及迭代轨迹配对，并提供智能体框架自动生成正确且高效的 CUDA 内核；其价值在于用小模型监督微调显著提升内核生成正确率，并给出可复用的监督构建流程。
cards.summaryEn: The authors build KernelMosaic, an open dataset pairing CUDA tasks expressed as natural-language descriptions, reference programs, and mathematical specifications with verified solutions and optimization trajectories, using an agentic framework to guide a strong model through implementation, repair, and performance tuning. The reported facts: supervised fine-tuning a small open-source model on KernelMosaic raises correctness on KernelBench L1, L2, and L3 from 4%, 0%, and 0% to 88%, 82%, and 16%, and increases the fraction of tasks with kernels faster than PyTorch eager at every level. The authors' view is that supervision from curated trajectories substantially outperforms direct-response supervision and promotes sustained testing and revision.
cards.whyItMatters: 为 CUDA 内核生成提供了开放的监督数据与可复现的轨迹构建流程，表明通用小模型可通过轨迹监督获得显著提升，并提示“过程监督”比仅监督最终答案更能引导测试与修订行为。
keyPointsEn: The dataset combines task specifications (natural language, reference programs, mathematical specs) with human-guided review and verified solutions plus optimization trajectories.
The agentic framework uses reusable CUDA guidance and execution feedback to drive a strong LLM through implementation, correctness repair, and performance optimization.
After supervised fine-tuning of a small model, KernelBench L1/L2/L3 correctness rises from 4%/0%/0% to 88%/82%/16%, and the share of kernels faster than PyTorch eager increases at every level.
cards.originalTitle: KernelMosaic: An Open Dataset and Agentic Framework for CUDA Kernel Generation
cards.descriptionEn: This work releases KernelMosaic, an open dataset pairing diverse CUDA tasks with verified solutions and iterative trajectories, plus an agentic framework that generates correct and efficient CUDA kernels; its value lies in substantially raising kernel-generation accuracy via supervised fine-tuning of a small model and in offering a reusable pipeline for building such supervision.
cards.limitations: 证据来自单一论文的实验设置：仅报告一个较小开源模型在 KernelBench 三个级别上的结果，未说明跨模型规模、其他 GPU 架构或更广任务分布的泛化性；L3 正确率仅 16%，任务难度上限明显；轨迹由强 LLM 加人工引导生成，其成本、可扩展性与潜在偏差未量化；性能比较仅相对 PyTorch eager，未涉及手工优化库等更强基线。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides open supervision data and a reproducible trajectory-building pipeline for CUDA kernel generation, showing that a general small model can gain substantially from trajectory supervision and suggesting that process-level supervision steers testing and revision better than final-answer-only supervision.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from a single paper's experimental setup: only one small open-source model is reported on three KernelBench levels, with no demonstration of generalization across model scales, other GPU architectures, or broader task distributions; L3 correctness is only 16%, a clear difficulty ceiling; trajectories are produced by a strong LLM with human guidance, and their cost, scalability, and potential biases are not quantified; performance comparisons are only against PyTorch eager, not stronger hand-optimized library baselines.
cards.title: KernelMosaic 数据集与智能体框架用于 CUDA 内核生成
cards.summary: 作者构建了 KernelMosaic：一个将自然语言描述、参考程序、数学规格等多形态 CUDA 任务与验证解、优化轨迹配对的开放数据集，并用智能体框架引导强模型完成实现、纠错与性能优化。事实是：在 KernelMosaic 上监督微调小型开源模型后，KernelBench L1、L2、L3 正确率分别从 4%、0%、0% 升至 88%、82%、16%，且各级别中快于 PyTorch eager 的任务比例上升。作者观点是：来自精选轨迹的监督显著优于直接答案监督，并能促进持续的测试与修订行为。
cards.titleEn: KernelMosaic: Open Dataset and Agentic Framework for CUDA Kernel Generation
keyPoints: 数据集同时包含任务规格（自然语言、参考程序、数学规格）与经人工引导审查的验证解和优化轨迹。
智能体框架借助可复用 CUDA 指导与执行反馈，驱动强 LLM 完成实现、正确性修复和性能优化。
小模型监督微调后 KernelBench L1/L2/L3 正确率由 4%/0%/0% 提升至 88%/82%/16%，快于 PyTorch eager 的任务比例亦上升。

cards.description: 提出一种数据驱动的连续时间强化学习方法，直接学习预承诺投资策略，无需估计未知市场系数；在无因子多股票Black-Scholes市场中给出算法并证明Sharpe比率的次线性遗憾界。
cards.summaryEn: This study addresses continuous-time mean-variance portfolio selection in markets where stock prices and observable factors are diffusion processes with unknown coefficients. Based on reinforcement learning theory for diffusion processes, the authors develop a data-driven approach that directly learns a pre-committed strategy, and for multi-stock Black-Scholes markets without factors, they design an algorithm and derive a sublinear regret bound. Empirical results on S&P 500 constituents show the strategy is robust and significantly outperforms model-based continuous-time counterparts, especially in volatile bear markets.
cards.whyItMatters: 为未知市场环境下的连续时间均值-方差投资组合选择提供无需模型估计的数据驱动方案，并给出理论性能保证，实证显示在波动熊市中具有优势。
keyPointsEn: A data-driven reinforcement learning approach directly learns a pre-committed investment strategy without estimating market coefficients.
An algorithm is designed for multi-stock Black-Scholes markets without factors, with a proven sublinear regret bound in terms of the Sharpe ratio.
Extensive empirical study on S&P 500 constituents shows the strategy performs among the best, especially in volatile bear markets, and decisively outperforms model-based continuous-time methods.
cards.originalTitle: Mean--Variance Portfolio Selection by Continuous-Time Reinforcement Learning: Algorithms, Regret Analysis, and Empirical Study
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes a data-driven continuous-time reinforcement learning approach that directly learns a pre-committed investment strategy without estimating unknown market coefficients; for multi-stock Black-Scholes markets without factors, an algorithm is devised with a sublinear regret bound in terms of the Sharpe ratio.
cards.limitations: 理论遗憾界仅针对无因子多股票Black-Scholes市场建立；实证基于标普500成分股，结论外推需谨慎；策略表现依赖历史数据与市场条件，不构成投资建议。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides a model-free, data-driven solution for continuous-time mean-variance portfolio selection with theoretical performance guarantees, and empirical evidence shows advantages in volatile bear markets.
cards.limitationsEn: The theoretical regret bound is established only for multi-stock Black-Scholes markets without factors; empirical results are based on S&P 500 constituents and extrapolation should be cautious; performance depends on historical data and market conditions, and does not constitute investment advice.
cards.title: 连续时间强化学习求解均值-方差投资组合选择
cards.summary: 研究在股票价格和可观测因子均为扩散过程但系数未知的市场中，连续时间均值-方差投资组合选择问题。作者基于扩散过程强化学习理论，提出直接学习预承诺策略的数据驱动方法，并在无因子多股票Black-Scholes市场中设计算法、推导次线性遗憾界。实证表明该策略在标普500成分股上表现稳健，尤其在波动熊市中显著优于基于模型的连续时间方法。
cards.titleEn: Continuous-Time Reinforcement Learning for Mean-Variance Portfolio Selection
keyPoints: 提出数据驱动强化学习方法，直接学习预承诺投资策略，避免估计市场系数。
针对无因子多股票Black-Scholes市场设计算法，并证明基于Sharpe比率的次线性遗憾界。
在标普500成分股上广泛实证，策略在波动熊市中表现突出，显著优于基于模型的连续时间方法。

cards.description: 该研究把回测过拟合校正从搜索结束后移到搜索循环内部，使接受阈值随试验次数与离散度变化，并分析其被搜索过程反向利用的风险。
cards.summaryEn: The paper notes that LLM-driven autonomous searches perform many implicit backtests before reporting results; if the deflation threshold is placed inside the loop, it becomes an object the search can optimize against. The author shows analytically that a naive in-loop bar admits a variance-dilution effect, in which many mediocre near-duplicate candidates lower the bar. Two defences are proposed, a pre-registered variance floor and a monotone high-water-mark bar, and evaluated under a protocol frozen before any run.
cards.whyItMatters: 对自动策略发现而言，过拟合校正若只放在搜索之后，可能低估搜索过程中大量隐式试验带来的选择偏差；把校正放入循环并设计防操纵门槛，是评估发现是否可信的关键环节。
keyPointsEn: Analysis shows that a naive in-loop threshold can be diluted because candidate dispersion falls faster than the trial-count factor grows, making it easier for the search to clear the bar.
Across 53 audited hundred-candidate searches, the gated search reported no certifiable discovery in 36 of 37 runs, while un-gated controls reported a strategy in all 16.
Every arm's out-of-sample confidence interval includes zero; a hundred nominal trials collapse to about 6 to 8 effectively independent return streams.
cards.originalTitle: Can a search hold its own bar? In-loop deflation and its exploits in autonomous strategy discovery
cards.descriptionEn: The study moves backtest-overfitting correction from after the search into the search loop, where the acceptance threshold responds to trial count and dispersion, and analyzes the risk that the search can exploit it.
cards.limitations: 结果为 53 组审计搜索、两个前沿模型、两个市场和两个特征空间的受控实验，作者明确将结论限定在所分析系统；所有样本外置信区间含零，不能据此认为存在可盈利策略。
cards.whyItMattersEn: For automated strategy discovery, correcting overfitting only after the search may underestimate selection bias from many implicit trials during the search; moving correction in-loop and designing manipulation-resistant gates is key to judging whether a discovery is credible.
cards.limitationsEn: Results come from 53 audited searches over two frontier models, two universes, and two feature spaces, and the author scopes conclusions to the analyzed system. All out-of-sample confidence intervals include zero, so the findings do not imply a profitable strategy exists.
cards.title: 搜索内阈值校正可抑制自主策略发现中的过拟合
cards.summary: 论文指出，LLM 驱动的自主搜索在报告结果前隐含进行大量回测，若把去膨胀阈值放进循环，阈值本身会成为可优化对象。作者证明朴素循环内门槛存在方差稀释效应，即大量近似重复的平庸候选项会拉低门槛。作者提出预注册方差下限与单调高水位门槛两种防御，并在冻结协议下进行审计评估。
cards.titleEn: In-loop threshold correction can curb overfitting in autonomous strategy discovery
keyPoints: 分析显示，朴素循环内阈值会因候选项离散度下降快于试验计数增长而被稀释，使搜索更容易通过门槛。
在 53 组各含一百个候选项的审计搜索中，带门槛搜索在 37 次运行中有 36 次报告无可认证发现，无门槛对照 16 次全部报告策略。
所有实验组样本外置信区间都包含零；一百个名义试验约只相当于 6 至 8 个有效独立收益流。

cards.description: 该研究针对实时竞价中仅能观测成功竞价价格（删失数据）的难题，提出并行探索子活动以构造一致价格估计，并给出基于模型的随机控制与无模型强化学习两种求解框架，为预算约束下的媒体交易决策提供理论工具。
cards.summaryEn: In real-time bidding, agencies balance campaign performance, transaction margins, and finite budgets, but clearing prices are only observed when bids succeed, making available information policy-dependent. The authors formulate a continuous-time stochastic control problem with a latent price process and construct a price signal via parallel exploratory subcampaigns with randomized bids under an upper bound, showing the estimator is consistent with a mean-square error bound of order N^{-1}. They propose a model-based approach combining forward-equation calibration with Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman policy iteration and a physics-informed neural network, alongside an entropy-regularized actor-critic model-free approach based on observable information, with synthetic experiments illustrating the procedures.
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架帮助厘清广告代理在实时竞价中面临的决策与信息权衡，将完全信息基准与基于估计价格的策略同真正部分观测控制问题区分开，为预算约束下的媒体交易提供可计算的理论路径。
keyPointsEn: Formulates media trading under censored prices as a continuous-time stochastic control problem with a latent price process, clarifying the coupling between information and decisions.
Designs parallel exploratory subcampaigns with randomized bids under an upper bound, yielding a consistent price estimator with mean-square error of order N^{-1}.
Proposes two computational frameworks: a model-based method (forward-equation calibration + HJB policy iteration + PINN) and a model-free entropy-regularized actor-critic method.
cards.originalTitle: Media Trading with Censored Auction Prices: A Stochastic Control and Reinforcement Learning Approach
cards.descriptionEn: This study addresses the challenge of censored price observations in real-time bidding, where market-clearing prices are only observed upon successful bids. It proposes parallel exploratory subcampaigns to construct a consistent price estimator and provides both model-based stochastic control and model-free reinforcement learning frameworks for budget-constrained media trading decisions.
cards.limitations: 估计量的相合性与均方误差界依赖风格化的横截面抽样模型；计算流程仅在合成实验中验证，未涉及真实竞价数据或实际市场表现；论文明确区分完全信息基准与部分观测策略，但未声称所提策略在真实环境中优于其他方法。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The framework helps clarify the decision and information trade-offs faced by advertising agencies in real-time bidding, distinguishing full-information benchmarks and estimated-price policies from the genuinely partially observed control problem, offering a computable theoretical path for budget-constrained media trading.
cards.limitationsEn: The consistency and mean-square error bound of the estimator rely on a stylized cross-sectional sampling model; computational procedures are validated only in synthetic experiments, without real bidding data or market performance; the paper explicitly distinguishes full-information benchmarks from partially observed policies and does not claim the proposed strategies outperform alternatives in real environments.
cards.title: 删失拍卖价格下的媒体交易：随机控制与强化学习方法
cards.summary: 实时竞价中，营销机构需平衡广告效果、交易利润与有限预算，但市场出清价格仅在竞价成功时被观测，导致可用信息依赖于竞价策略。作者将问题建模为含潜在价格过程的连续时间随机控制问题，通过并行探索子活动（随机化竞价并设上限）构造价格信号，证明估计量一致且均方误差界为N^{-1}。进一步提出基于前向方程校准与HJB策略迭代的模型方法（含物理信息神经网络），以及基于可观测信息的熵正则化actor-critic无模型方法，并用合成实验验证。
cards.titleEn: Media Trading with Censored Auction Prices: Stochastic Control and Reinforcement Learning Approaches
keyPoints: 将删失价格下的媒体交易建模为含潜在价格过程的连续时间随机控制问题，明确信息与决策的耦合。
设计并行探索子活动，在竞价上限内随机化出价，得到一致价格估计且均方误差以N^{-1}收敛。
提出模型方法（前向方程校准+HJB策略迭代+PINN）与无模型方法（熵正则化actor-critic）两种计算框架。

cards.description: 提出一种面向电池储能系统（BESS）交易问题的日内电价预测目标变量，并嵌入短视滚动内在策略，在2023–2024高频模拟中较朴素方法提升利润最高42%。
cards.summaryEn: The paper addresses BESS trading in continuous intraday markets, noting that existing price forecasts focus on end-of-trading volume-weighted prices and fail to capture features most relevant to BESS trading. The authors introduce a novel target variable derived from the limit order book and its dynamics to produce distributional forecasts that inform a rolling intrinsic policy. Simulations show profit improvements up to 42%, an inverse relationship between forecast accuracy and stability, and joint influence of BESS size and duration on marginal forecast benefits.
cards.whyItMatters: 为BESS在日内市场变现灵活性提供了一套计算高效且与交易目标对齐的预测—优化框架，并揭示了预测精度与稳定性之间的权衡，对量化交易策略设计有参考价值。
keyPointsEn: A new forecast target derived from limit order book dynamics replaces end-of-trading volume-weighted prices, better aligned with BESS trading needs
Distributional forecasts are embedded into a myopic rolling intrinsic policy, avoiding the computational burden of full stochastic optimization
High-frequency simulations for 2023–2024 show profit improvements up to 42% over the naive rolling intrinsic formulation
cards.originalTitle: Improving Algorithmic Trading for BESS on Intraday Electricity Markets through Distributional Price Forecasts
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes a BESS-tailored intraday price forecast target embedded into a myopic rolling intrinsic policy, improving simulated profits by up to 42% over the naive formulation in 2023–2024 high-frequency simulations.
cards.limitations: 结论基于2023–2024某市场的高频模拟，未涉及实盘交易；利润提升幅度依赖模拟假设与市场条件；精度与稳定性的反向关系及BESS规模/时长的影响为实证观察，外推需谨慎。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Provides a computationally efficient forecast-optimization framework aligned with BESS flexibility monetization in intraday markets and highlights the accuracy-stability trade-off, offering reference value for quantitative trading strategy design.
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions are based on high-frequency simulations for 2023–2024 in a specific market setting, without live trading; profit gains depend on simulation assumptions and market conditions; the inverse accuracy-stability relationship and the influence of BESS size/duration are empirical observations requiring cautious extrapolation.
cards.title: 基于分布价格预测的日内市场电池交易优化
cards.summary: 论文针对BESS在连续日内市场交易，指出现有电价预测多关注交易末段成交量加权价格，未能捕捉BESS交易最相关的特征。作者从限价订单簿及其动态中构造新目标变量，生成分布价格预测以指导滚动内在策略。模拟结果显示利润提升最高42%，并发现预测精度与稳定性存在反向关系，BESS规模和时长共同影响预测的边际收益。
cards.titleEn: Distributional Price Forecasts for BESS Algorithmic Trading in Intraday Electricity Markets
keyPoints: 从限价订单簿动态构造新预测目标，替代末段成交量加权价格，更贴合BESS交易需求
将分布预测嵌入短视滚动内在策略，避免全随机优化的计算负担
2023–2024高频模拟中利润较朴素滚动内在策略提升最高42%

cards.description: 提出延迟同态强化学习（DHRL）框架，利用MDP同态引入信念等价关系，将增广状态空间压缩为紧凑抽象空间，在确定性动态下实现精确抽象，随机动态下实现近似抽象，统一受益于行动者和评论家。
cards.summaryEn: The paper addresses delayed feedback violating the Markov assumption by proposing DHRL, which uses MDP homomorphisms with a belief-equivalence relation to compress augmented state spaces into a compact abstract space. Theoretical analysis shows that in finite domains, exact abstraction preserves optimality and recovers delay-free sample-complexity order, while approximate abstraction bounds value loss. The deep instantiation D²HPG outperforms strong augmentation baselines on MuJoCo continuous-control benchmarks, especially in long-delay regimes.
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法为延迟反馈强化学习提供统一抽象机制，有望缓解增广状态空间爆炸带来的样本复杂度负担，提升长延迟场景下的学习与控制性能。
keyPointsEn: DHRL collapses control-redundant augmented states into a compact abstract state space via belief-equivalence, providing a unified abstraction mechanism for both actor and critic.
In finite domains, exact abstraction preserves optimality and recovers delay-free sample-complexity order, while approximate abstraction bounds policy value loss.
The deep instantiation D²HPG outperforms augmentation-based baselines on MuJoCo continuous-control benchmarks, with larger gains in long-delay settings.
cards.originalTitle: Delayed homomorphic reinforcement learning for environments with delayed feedback
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes delayed homomorphic reinforcement learning (DHRL), a framework grounded in MDP homomorphisms that introduces a belief-equivalence relation to collapse augmented state spaces into a compact abstract space, achieving exact abstraction under deterministic dynamics and approximate abstraction under stochastic dynamics, benefiting both actor and critic.
cards.limitations: 理论保证主要针对有限域，连续域仅提供深度实例化而无理论保证；实验限于MuJoCo连续控制基准，未涵盖真实系统延迟或高维复杂环境；近似抽象的值损失上界在实际中的紧致性未经验证。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This approach offers a unified abstraction mechanism for delayed-feedback reinforcement learning, potentially alleviating sample-complexity burdens from augmented state-space explosion and improving learning and control in long-delay scenarios.
cards.limitationsEn: Theoretical guarantees mainly target finite domains, with only a deep instantiation for continuous domains without guarantees; experiments are limited to MuJoCo continuous-control benchmarks and do not cover real-system delays or high-dimensional complex environments; the tightness of the approximate abstraction value-loss bound is not empirically verified.
cards.title: 延迟反馈强化学习：同态抽象统一优化行动者与评论家
cards.summary: 论文针对延迟反馈违反马尔可夫假设的问题，提出基于MDP同态的DHRL框架，通过信念等价关系将增广状态空间压缩为紧凑抽象空间。理论分析表明，在有限域中精确抽象保持最优性并恢复无延迟样本复杂度阶数，近似抽象则给出策略值损失上界。作者在MuJoCo连续控制基准上实例化深度延迟同态策略梯度（D²HPG），实验显示其优于强增广基线，尤其在长延迟情形。
cards.titleEn: Delayed Homomorphic Reinforcement Learning: Unifying Actor and Critic via Homomorphic Abstraction
keyPoints: DHRL通过信念等价关系将控制冗余的增广状态折叠为紧凑抽象状态空间，统一为行动者和评论家提供抽象机制。
在有限域中，精确抽象保持最优性并恢复无延迟样本复杂度阶数，近似抽象则给出策略值损失上界。
深度实例化D²HPG在MuJoCo连续控制基准上优于增广基线，长延迟下优势更明显。

cards.description: 该工作提出 MLIRBench，用经执行验证的 torch 与 linalg 程序对构造等价、分歧或报错判定任务，区分模型是真正理解 MLIR 程序行为还是依赖训练模式，为编译器 IR 语义推理提供可复现基准。
cards.summaryEn: The paper releases MLIRBench, a benchmark of 1,768 execution-validated MLIR program pairs (888 linalg, 880 torch) labeled EQUIV, DIVERGE, or ERROR. Nine models were evaluated, with Gemini 3.1 Pro reporting the highest hard-label accuracy of 92.65%, an aggregate score of 74.18, and a judge-assigned result-behavior score of 5.04/10. The authors conclude that strong semantic classification does not imply accurate prediction of fine-grained execution behavior, highlighting a gap in LLM reasoning over compiler IRs.
cards.whyItMatters: 编译器 IR 显式表达操作、数据流与执行语义，是检验 LLM 是否真正理解程序行为而非复述训练模式的合适场景；MLIRBench 通过执行验证的程序对提供可复现评测基础，可支撑程序修复与语义分类等相关研究。
keyPointsEn: The dataset has 1,768 execution-validated program pairs from linalg and torch sources, labeled EQUIV, DIVERGE, or ERROR
Nine models were evaluated (five open-weight, four proprietary); Gemini 3.1 Pro had the highest hard-label accuracy at 92.65%
The same model scored 74.18 aggregate and 5.04/10 on result-behavior judging, showing a gap between classification and execution-behavior prediction
cards.originalTitle: MLIRBench - A Benchmark and Dataset for Compiler and Hardware-Aware Reasoning
cards.descriptionEn: This work introduces MLIRBench, which builds execution-validated torch and linalg program pairs labeled equivalent, divergent, or erroneous, to test whether models truly understand MLIR program behavior rather than relying on training patterns, offering a reproducible benchmark for semantic reasoning over compiler IRs.
cards.limitations: 结果仅基于论文自建的 1,768 个程序对与作者定义的三类标签，未说明其覆盖的 MLIR 方言、算子与程序复杂度范围；评测限于九个模型的一次性报告，未提供多次运行的方差或统计显著性；综合得分与 5.04/10 的评审分依赖作者设定的评分与评审流程，其可复现性与评审一致性需进一步确认；基准结论不能外推到其他 IR 或真实编译优化任务，也不构成任何模型选型或投资建议。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Compiler IRs explicitly encode operations, dataflow, and execution semantics, making them a suitable setting to test whether LLMs genuinely understand program behavior instead of reciting training patterns; MLIRBench's execution-validated pairs provide a reproducible evaluation basis that can support related work such as program repair and semantic classification.
cards.limitationsEn: Results rest only on the paper's own 1,768 program pairs and author-defined three-way labels, without detailing the covered MLIR dialects, operators, or program complexity. Evaluation is a single reported run over nine models, with no variance across repeated runs or statistical significance. The aggregate score and the 5.04/10 judge score depend on author-specified scoring and judging procedures whose reproducibility and judge consistency need further confirmation. Findings should not be extrapolated to other IRs or real compiler optimization tasks, and do not constitute model-selection or investment advice.
cards.title: MLIRBench：评估大模型对编译器中间表示的执行语义推理
cards.summary: 论文发布 MLIRBench 基准，含 1,768 个经执行验证的 MLIR 程序对（888 个 linalg、880 个 torch），标签为 EQUIV、DIVERGE、ERROR。作者在九个模型上评测，报告 Gemini 3.1 Pro 硬标签准确率 92.65%、综合得分 74.18、评审给出的结果行为分 5.04/10。作者据此认为强语义分类能力不等于能准确预测细粒度执行行为，指出当前 LLM 在编译器 IR 推理上的缺口。
cards.titleEn: MLIRBench: Evaluating LLM Reasoning over Compiler IR Execution Semantics
keyPoints: 数据集规模为 1,768 个执行验证程序对，含 linalg 与 torch 两类来源，标签分 EQUIV、DIVERGE、ERROR
评测覆盖九个模型（五个开放权重、四个专有），Gemini 3.1 Pro 硬标签准确率最高，为 92.65%
同一模型综合得分为 74.18、结果行为评审分为 5.04/10，显示分类与执行行为预测之间存在落差

cards.description: 该研究提出MindMem框架，将共享经历异步整合为角色、用户及关系的心智状态，并引入长时程基准MemReal-Bench，以区分事实回忆与情境化记忆运用。
cards.summaryEn: The research notes that mainstream conversational memory systems rely on passive semantic similarity over external fact stores, often retrieving topically similar records while missing relationally pivotal experiences. Inspired by cognitive psychology's Self-Memory System, the authors propose MindMem, which asynchronously consolidates shared experiences into mental states of the character, user, and their relationship, and uses a mental-state reasoner to proactively recover episodic evidence. On MemReal-Bench, MindMem reaches 59.03% SMR and 82.58% DQA, exceeding the strongest baseline by 24.19 and 9.19 percentage points, respectively, and outperforming oracle target-memory injection on SMR.
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为长期角色对话中的历史敏感适应提供了新思路，强调关系性关键经历而非仅主题相似性，并给出可区分事实回忆与情境化运用的评测基准。
keyPointsEn: MindMem asynchronously consolidates shared experiences into mental states of the character, user, and relationship, rather than merely storing external facts.
A specialized mental-state reasoner contextualizes persistent states at each turn to anticipate latent user needs and recover episodic evidence overlooked by surface-level matching.
MemReal-Bench pairs direct question answering with situated memory realization to test whether agents can naturally use shared history, world rules, and relational trajectories.
cards.originalTitle: We Are What We Remember: Mental-State-Driven Memory for Long-Term Character Dialogue
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes MindMem, a framework that asynchronously consolidates shared experiences into mental states of the character, user, and relationship, and introduces the longitudinal benchmark MemReal-Bench to distinguish factual recall from situated memory use.
cards.limitations: 证据来自作者在MemReal-Bench上的实验，基准基于为期一个月的真实用户交互但场景限于双人和群体对话；未说明跨文化、跨领域泛化能力及计算开销；oracle目标记忆注入的比较范围有限。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work offers a new approach to history-sensitive adaptation in long-term character dialogue, emphasizing relationally pivotal experiences rather than topical similarity alone, and provides a benchmark that distinguishes factual recall from situated memory use.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from the authors' experiments on MemReal-Bench, a benchmark grounded in month-long real-user interactions but limited to dyadic and group dialogue scenes; cross-cultural and cross-domain generalization and computational overhead are not addressed; the comparison with oracle target-memory injection is limited in scope.
cards.title: 心智状态驱动记忆框架提升长期角色对话表现
cards.summary: 研究指出主流对话记忆系统依赖外部事实库的被动语义相似度，常检索主题相似却遗漏关系关键经历。作者受认知心理学自我记忆系统启发，提出MindMem，将共享经历异步整合为角色、用户及关系的心智状态，并由心智状态推理器主动调用情节证据。在MemReal-Bench上，MindMem的SMR达59.03%、DQA达82.58%，分别超过最强基线24.19和9.19个百分点，并在SMR上优于 oracle 目标记忆注入。
cards.titleEn: Mental-State-Driven Memory Framework Improves Long-Term Character Dialogue
keyPoints: MindMem将共享经历异步整合为角色、用户及关系的心智状态，而非仅存储外部事实。
专用心智状态推理器在每轮对话中情境化持久状态，预测用户潜在需求并恢复被表层匹配遗漏的情节证据。
MemReal-Bench结合直接问答与情境化记忆实现，测试智能体能否自然运用共享历史、世界规则和关系轨迹。

cards.description: 该GitHub项目将市场分析、技术图表、经济日历、筛选器与交易策略开发等功能封装为Claude Code技能，新在把AI编码助手工作流引入股票投研场景，便于在统一环境中调用分析能力；项目仅有描述性概要，未提供验证结果。
cards.summaryEn: This is a GitHub repository collecting Claude Code skills for equity investing and trading, covering market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners and trading-strategy development. The feature scope is the project's own description and stated claim; no backtests, empirical results or code-quality assessments are provided.
cards.whyItMatters: 对量化与投研人员而言，它展示了把AI编码助手嵌入日常分析流程的一种组织方式，可作为评估技能化投研工具形态的参考样本。
keyPointsEn: The repository is positioned as a Claude Code skill collection for equity investors and traders.
It claims five areas: market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners and trading-strategy development.
No verifiable performance metrics or backtest results are presented on the project page.
cards.descriptionEn: This GitHub project packages market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners and trading-strategy development as Claude Code skills. Its novelty lies in bringing an AI coding-assistant workflow into equity research, but only a descriptive summary is available with no validated results.
cards.limitations: 信息仅来自GitHub Trending的仓库简介，未获取README细节、代码实现、数据来源、回测方法或用户反馈；无法判断各技能的准确性、时效性与适用市场，也不能据此推断实际投资收益。
cards.whyItMattersEn: For quantitative and research practitioners, it illustrates one way to embed an AI coding assistant into daily analysis workflows and serves as a reference sample for evaluating skill-based research tooling.
cards.limitationsEn: Information comes only from the GitHub Trending repository summary; README details, code implementation, data sources, backtest methodology and user feedback were not obtained. The skills' accuracy, timeliness and applicable markets cannot be judged, nor can actual investment returns be inferred.
cards.title: 面向股票投资者与交易者的Claude Code技能库发布
cards.summary: 这是一个汇总股票投资与交易相关Claude Code技能的GitHub仓库，覆盖市场分析、技术图表、经济日历、筛选器和交易策略开发。上述功能范围为仓库自述内容，属于项目方主张；未提供回测、实证效果或代码质量评估。
cards.titleEn: Claude Code skill library released for equity investors and traders
keyPoints: 仓库定位为股票投资者与交易者的Claude Code技能集合。
自述覆盖市场分析、技术图表、经济日历、筛选器和交易策略开发五类功能。
项目页未给出可验证的性能指标或回测结果。

cards.description: 本卡内容来自 GitHub Trending Daily 对 backnotprop/plannotator 的项目简介，介绍一个用于跟踪智能体、整理反馈并一键回传的工作台定位；新意在于把规划、标注、代码评审与团队协作汇总到单一交互入口。
cards.summaryEn: The project describes itself as a workspace to stay in the loop with agents, supporting shaping, deciding, planning, annotating, code review and team sharing. Its main claim is one-click delivery of all feedback to agents. These are the project's own descriptions; no implementation details or effectiveness data are provided.
cards.whyItMatters: 若自述功能成立，可减少人工在多个工具间搬运反馈的成本，帮助团队对智能体输出做集中评审与决策；但输入未给出可用性证据。
keyPointsEn: Positioned as a workspace for tracking and controlling agents
